preconditions.description: The number of nodes N is an integer between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U <= N and 1 <= V <= N for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for U, V in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each edge is represented by two integers U and V, where 1 ≤ U, V ≤ N, and there are exactly N-1 edges forming a tree.
The input consists of exactly N lines: the first line is N, followed by N-1 lines of edges.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum number of connected components achievable after any number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(stdout.strip()) <= N for _ in range(int(stdout.strip())))
postconditions.description: The output integer is a feasible count of connected components, where each component is a non-empty subtree formed by removing leaf nodes and their ancestors.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == max(len(components) for components in possible_component_sets)
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of connected components achievable by iteratively removing leaf nodes and their ancestors, where each removal splits the tree into smaller subtrees.
